verdict_metadata.source_institution: Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), Boston, MA, USA

verdict_justification: BioMarkerX demonstrates partial transportability when deployed across institutions from Emory University Hospital (Set A) to Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (Set B). While bedside alarm precision (Confirmation PPV: 35.82% vs 32.14%) and lead time (40.0h vs 36.0h) are well-preserved, overall model discrimination (AUROC: 0.7161 vs 0.7895) and patient sensitivity (64.56% vs 84.95%) exhibit moderate domain degradation due to measurement-density and missingness shifts in Set B.
